Bioinformatics Plotting Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release introducing a comprehensive bioinformatics data visualization skill.
- Provides platform overview, usage instructions, and when to use the skill.
- Includes a decision guide for picking plot types based on data and analysis needs.
- Features a detailed catalog of 57 bar/column chart tools available on the 微生信/SRplot platform.
- All descriptions and tool links are documented for easy user reference.
